examples.text: so tena kammena evaṃ samattena evaṃ samādiṇṇena kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
tass'eva kho pana pubbe aviddasuno upadhī honti samattā samādinnā. ty'āssa pahīnā honti ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.

yadā tumhe, kālāmā, attanā'va jāneyyātha, ime dhammā akusalā, ime dhammā sāvajjā, ime dhammā viññugarahitā, ime dhammā samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattantī'ti, atha tumhe, kālāmā, pajaheyyātha.

59603.commentary: (MNa) sv'āssā'ti dhūmachārik'ādīnaṃ abhāvena so assa aggi accimā ca vaṇṇimā ca pabhassaro cā'ti.

examples.text: tejo pātukato sv'āssa aggi na c'eva accimā na ca vaṇṇavā na ca pabhassaro, na ca tena sakkā agginā aggikaraṇīyaṃ kātun'ti?

59604.meaning1: fact of being adopted; fact of having undertaken
59604.construction:
saṃ + √ādā > ādī + na + tta
samādinna + tta
59604.commentary: (SNa) yesaṃ dhammānaṃ samādinnattā sakko sakkattaṃ ajjhagā, tañ'ca pajānāmī'ti. ayaṃ sakkassa sakkat'tādhigame saṅkhepakathā, vitthāro pana sumaṅgalavilāsiniyā dīghanikāy'aṭṭhakathāya sakkapaṇhavaṇṇanāyaṃ vutto.

examples.text: sakkassa, bhikkhave, devānam'indassa pubbe manussabhūtassa imāni satta vatapadāni samattāni samādinnāni ahesuṃ, yesaṃ samādinnattā sakko sakkattaṃ ajjhagā'ti.

59606.commentary: (DNa) tapaṃ samādiyatī'ti acelakabhāv'ādikaṃ tapaṃ sammā ādiyati, daḷhaṃ gaṇhāti.

examples.text: yo kho, brāhmaṇa, pasannacitto sikkhāpadāni samādiyati, pāṇ'ātipātā veramaṇiṃ, adinn'ādānā veramaṇiṃ, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇiṃ, musāvādā veramaṇiṃ, surā-meraya-majja-pamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇiṃ.
upehi saraṇaṃ buddhaṃ, dhammaṃ saṅghañ'ca tādinaṃ, samādiyāhi sīlāni, taṃ te atthāya hehiti.

evam'pi kho ahaṃ, bhante, na ussahāmi bhuñjituṃ, evam'pi hi me, bhante, bhuñjato siyā kukkuccaṃ, siyā vippaṭisāro'ti. atha kho āyasmā bhaddāli bhagavatā sikkhāpade paññāpiyamāne bhikkhusaṅghe sikkhaṃ samādiyamāne anussāhaṃ pavedesi.
sambahulā bhikkhū santhatāni ujjhitvā āraññik'aṅgaṃ piṇḍapātik'aṅgaṃ paṃsukūlik'aṅgaṃ samādiyiṃsu

59610.meaning2: should be undertaken; to be adopted

examples.text: so tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye saddhaṃ samādiyitvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā sutaṃ samādiyitvā cāgaṃ samādiyitvā paññaṃ samādiyitvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajji devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ. so aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena c'eva yasasā ca.
samādiyitvā buddhaguṇaṃ, daḷhaṃ katvāna mānasaṃ, dīpaṅ'karaṃ namassitvā, āsanā vuṭṭhahiṃ tadā.
app'ossukko tvaṃ, mahārāja, vīthiyo sodhāpetvā… saparijano uposathaṃ samādiyitvā… sāyanhasamaye mahānāgavan'uyyān'ābhimukho yāhi addhā tasmiṃ ṭhāne dhātuyo lacchasī'ti
sādhu, bhante, bhagavā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ samādisatu, yo uttarimanussadhammā, iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissati, ev'āyaṃ nāḷandā bhiyyoso mattāya bhagavati abhippasīdissatī'ti.

59616.meaning1: highest meditative composure; superior stability of mind

examples.text: katamāni cattāri? sīl'aggaṃ, samādh'aggaṃ, paññā'ggaṃ, vimutt'aggaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri aggānī'ti.

59617.meaning1: for the purpose of stability of mind; for the sake of meditative composure

examples.text: samādhi yathābhūtañāṇadassan'attho yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, sukhaṃ samādh'atthaṃ samādh'ānisaṃsaṃ, passaddhi sukh'atthā sukh'ānisaṃsā, pīti passaddh'atthā passaddh'ānisaṃsā

59618.meaning1: ruled by stability of mind; governed by meditative composure

examples.text: katame cattāro? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo na sīlagaru hoti na sīl'ādhipateyyo, na samādhigaru hoti na samādh'ādhipateyyo, na paññāgaru hoti na paññ'ādhipateyyo.

59619.commentary: (MNt) samādhānato'ti sammā cittassa ādhānato ṭhapanato. (VISMa) cittacetasikānaṃ samaṃ avisāravasena sampiṇḍentassa viya ādhānaṃ samādhānaṃ. avisāralakkhaṇo hi samādhi, sampiṇḍanaraso ca. sammā avikkhipanavasena ādhānaṃ samādhānaṃ. avikkhepalakkhaṇo vā hi samādhi, vikkhepaviddhaṃsanaraso cā'ti. sv'āyaṃ yasmā ekārammaṇe cittassa ṭhitihetu, tasmā ṭhapanan'ti vuttaṃ hotī'ti āha.

examples.text: tattha katamo samatho? yā cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti ṭhānaṃ paṭṭhānaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ samādhi samādhānaṃ avikkhepo avippaṭisāro vūpasamo mānaso ek'aggaṃ cittassa, ayaṃ samatho.
ken'aṭṭhena samādhī'ti samādhān'aṭṭhena samādhi. kim'idaṃ samādhānaṃ nāma? ekārammaṇe cittacetasikānaṃ samaṃ sammā ca ādhānaṃ, ṭhapanan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

59621.meaning1: for the benefit of stability of mind; for the advantage of meditative composure

examples.text: samādhi yathābhūtañāṇadassan'attho yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, sukhaṃ samādh'atthaṃ samādh'ānisaṃsaṃ, passaddhi sukh'atthā sukh'ānisaṃsā, pīti passaddh'atthā passaddh'ānisaṃsā
kandanti naṃ ñātī pakiriya kese, ahovatā no amarā'ti c'āhu, vatthena naṃ pārutaṃ nīharitvā, citaṃ samādhāya tatoḍahanti.

59623.meaning1: perfect peace of mind; stability of mind; stillness of mind; meditative composure

examples.text: asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha, saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca, sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, jahissatha dukkham'idaṃ anappakaṃ.
saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa upaṭṭhitassatino etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ vossagg'ārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhissati samādhiṃ, labhissati cittassa ek'aggataṃ.

59624.commentary: (SNa) upekkhā dhurasamādhī'ti dhurassa samādhi, unnatonatākārassa abhāvena dvinnam'pi yugapadesānaṃ samatā'ti attho. ayañ'hi tatramajjhattupekkhā citt'uppādassa līn'uddhaccabhāvaṃ haritvā payogamajjhatte cittaṃ ṭhapeti, tasmā imassa maggarathassa, dhurasamādhī'ti vuttā.

examples.text: ratho sīlaparikkhāro, jhān'akkho cakkavīriyo, upekkhā dhurasamādhi, anicchā parivāraṇaṃ.
ek'ūnatiṃso vayasā subhadda, yaṃ pabbajiṃ kiṃkusal'ānuesī, vassāni paññāsa samādhikāni, yato ahaṃ pabbajito subhadda.
vassāni paññāsa samādhikāni, vasimha selassa guhāya romaka, asaṅkamānā abhinibbutattā, hatth'attam'āyanti mam'aṇḍajā pure.

59626.meaning1: talk about stability of mind; discussion about meditative composure

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā vīriy'ārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā

59627.meaning1: expert in meditative stability; skilled in internal peace; (comm) skilled in defining the factors of samādhi
59627.commentary: (SNa) samādhikusalo'ti paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ pañc'aṅgikaṃ dutiyaṃ ti'v'aṅgikan'ti evaṃ aṅgavavatthānakusalo.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yv'āyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro cā'ti.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo. idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo.

59628.meaning1: category of mental stability; class of meditative composure

examples.text: yo ca sammāvāyāmo yā ca sammāsati yo ca sammāsamādhi ime dhammā samādhikkhandhe saṅgahitā. yā ca sammādiṭṭhi yo ca sammāsaṅkappo, ime dhammā paññākkhandhe saṅgahitā'ti.

59629.meaning1: valuing stability of mind; giving weight to meditative composure
59629.commentary: (VISMa) sā pana yasmā samādhiṃ garuṃ katvā tattha ninnapoṇapabbhārabhāvena pavattiyā hoti, tasmā samādhigarū'ti-ādi vuttaṃ.

examples.text: katame cattāro? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo na sīlagaru hoti na sīl'ādhipateyyo, na samādhigaru hoti na samādh'ādhipateyyo, na paññāgaru hoti na paññ'ādhipateyyo.

59630.meaning1: highest meditative composure; superior stability of mind

examples.text: katamāni cattāri? sīl'aggaṃ, samādhi'ggaṃ, paññā'ggaṃ, vimutt'aggaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri aggānī'ti.

59632.meaning1: born from stable mind; produced by samadhi; produced by meditative composure

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso, etadahosi, idha bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

59633.meaning1: refined and true perception of the delight and ease born from meditative composure
59633.meaning2: refined and true perception of the delight and ease born from mental composure
59633.sanskrit: samādhi + ja + prīti + sukha + sūkṣma + satya + saṃjñā

examples.text: tassa yā purimā vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. samādhija-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, samādhija-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti.

59634.meaning1: with a refined and true perception of the delight and ease born from meditative composure
59634.meaning2: with refined and true perception of the delight and ease born from mental composure
59634.sanskrit: samādhi + ja + prīti + sukha + sūkṣma + satya + saṃjñin

examples.text: tassa yā purimā vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. samādhija-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, samādhija-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

59635.meaning1: bound by gratification to the joy and happiness born from stability of mind
59635.sanskrit: samādhi + ja + prīti + sukha + āsvāda + grathita

examples.text: tassa samādhijapītisukh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti samādhija-pītisukh'assāda-gadhitaṃ samādhija-pītisukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ samādhijapītisukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

59636.meaning1: bound with a chain to the gratification from the joy and happiness born from stability of mind
59636.sanskrit: samādhi + ja + prīti + sukha + āsvāda + saṃyojana + saṃyukta

examples.text: tassa samādhijapītisukh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti samādhija-pītisukh'assāda-gadhitaṃ samādhija-pītisukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ samādhijapītisukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

59637.meaning1: bound by the gratification from the joy and happiness produced by stability of mind

examples.text: tassa samādhijapītisukh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti samādhija-pītisukh'assāda-gadhitaṃ samādhija-pītisukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ samādhijapītisukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

59638.meaning1: following the joy and happiness born from stability of mind

examples.text: tassa samādhijapītisukh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti samādhija-pītisukh'assāda-gadhitaṃ samādhija-pītisukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ samādhijapītisukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

59639.meaning1: with a stable mind; with meditative composure; with samādhi
59639.construction:
saṃ + ā + √dhā + i + inā
samādhi + inā
59639.commentary: (ANa) appamāṇasamādhinā'ti arahattamaggasamādhinā. (UDa) āneñjasamādhinā'ti catutthajjhānapādakena aggaphalasamādhinā, arūpajjhānapādakenā'ti'pi vadanti. āneñjena samādhinā'ti'pi pāṭho.

examples.text: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā, abhibhuyya disā sabbā, appamāṇasamādhinā.

59640.meaning1: cause for meditative composure; basis for mental stillness
59640.commentary: (ANa) kālena kālaṃ samādhinimittaṃ manasikātabban'ti-ādīsu taṃ taṃ kālaṃ sallakkhetvā ek'aggatāya yuttakāle ek'aggatā manasikātabbā. ek'aggatā hi idha samādhinimittan'ti vuttā. tatra vacan'attho, samādhi'y'eva nimittaṃ samādhinimittaṃ.

examples.text: adhicittam'anuyuttena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tīṇi nimittāni kālena kālaṃ manasi kātabbāni, kālena kālaṃ samādhinimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ, kālena kālaṃ paggahanimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ, kālena kālaṃ upekkhānimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ.
katamo pan'āyye, samādhi, katame dhammā samādhinimittā, katame dhammā samādhiparikkhārā, katamā samādhibhāvanā'ti?

59641.meaning1: power of a collected mind; faculty of meditative stability

examples.text: aparāni'pi pañc'indriyāni saddh'indriyaṃ vīriy'indriyaṃ sat'indriyaṃ samādh'indriyaṃ paññ'indriyaṃ
tassa cittaṃ rakkhato āsavesu ca sāsavesu ca dhammesu… samādh'indriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. paññindriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.

59642.compound: dvanda (samādhi ca paññā ca vimutti ca)

59643.meaning1: state of meditative composure; attainment of mental peace

examples.text: siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā imasmiñ'ca saviññāṇake kāye ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'ānusayā n'āssu
siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā n'eva pathaviyaṃ pathavisaññī assa

59644.meaning1: requisite ingredient of mental stability; requirement for meditative composure

examples.text: katamo pan'āyye, samādhi, katame dhammā samādhinimittā, katame dhammā samādhiparikkhārā, katamā samādhibhāvanā'ti?

59646.meaning1: nurtured by stability of mind; fortified by meditative composure

examples.text: sīlaparibhāvito samādhi mahapphalo hoti mah'ānisaṃso. samādhiparibhāvitā paññā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā. paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ samma'd'eva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyath'idaṃ, kām'āsavā, bhav'āsavā, avijj'āsavā'ti.

59647.meaning1: headed by stillness; with meditative stability in front

examples.text: te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsamudayā'ti? phassasamudayā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsamosaraṇā'ti? vedanāsamosaraṇā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃpamukhā'ti? samādhippamukhā, bhante'ti.
samādhippamukhā sabbe dhammā, sat'ādhipateyyā sabbe dhammā, paññ'uttarā sabbe dhammā, vimuttisārā sabbe dhammā, amat'ogadhā sabbe dhammā, nibbānapariyosānā sabbe dhammā'ti.

59648.meaning1: power that is meditative composure; strength of perfect peace of mind

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, udāyi, akkhātā mayā sāvakānaṃ paṭipadā, yathāpaṭipannā me sāvakā pañca balāni bhāventi. idh'udāyi, bhikkhu samādhibalaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ. tatra ca pana me sāvakā bahū abhiññāvosānapāramippattā viharanti.

59650.meaning1: development of mental stability; cultivation of meditative composure

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satisampajaññāya saṃvattati, atthi, bhikkhave, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattati.
katamo pan'āyye, samādhi, katame dhammā samādhinimittā, katame dhammā samādhiparikkhārā, katamā samādhibhāvanā'ti?

59663.meaning1: is calmed; becomes collected; becomes composed; becomes stable (for)
59663.commentary: (MNa) samādhiyatī'ti sammā ṭhapiyati, appanāpattaṃ viya hoti. (ANa) samādhiyatī'ti ārammaṇe sammā ṭhapitaṃ hoti.

examples.text: passaddhisambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. passaddhakāyassa sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
tassa kāye kāy'ānupassino viharato cittaṃ na samādhiyati, upakkilesā na pahīyanti. so taṃ nimittaṃ na uggaṇhāti.

59665.meaning1: attainment of mental stillness; success in stability of mind; being accomplished in meditative composure

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca samādhisampanno samādhisampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

appamatto samāno samādhisampadaṃ ārādheti. so tāya samādhisampadāya attamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṅkappo. so tāya samādhisampadāya attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti, aham'asmi samāhito ek'aggacitto, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū asamāhitā vibbhantacittā'ti.

59666.meaning1: talk about the attainment of mental stillness; discussion about success in meditative composure

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca samādhisampanno samādhisampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

59667.meaning1: for the benefit of attaining mental stillness; for the advantage of accomplishment in meditative composure

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, na'y'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃsaṃ, na sīlasampad'ānisaṃsaṃ, na samādhisampad'ānisaṃsaṃ, na ñāṇadassan'ānisaṃsaṃ. yā ca kho ayaṃ, bhikkhave, akuppā cetovimutti, etadattham'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ, etaṃ sāraṃ etaṃ pariyosānan'ti.

59668.meaning1: skilled in mental stillness; with good meditation; accomplished in meditative composure

examples.text: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū sīlasampannā samādhisampannā ñāṇasampannā vimuttisampannā vimuttiñāṇadassanasampannā, dassanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi
ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca samādhisampanno samādhisampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

59669.meaning1: more skilled in meditative composure; more accomplished in stability of mind (than)
59669.commentary: (SNa) sīlasampannataran'ti sīlena sampannataraṃ, adhikataran'ti attho. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo. ettha ca sīl'ādayo cattāro dhammā lokiyalok'uttarā kathitā, vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ lokiyam'eva. paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ h'etaṃ.

examples.text: na kho pan'āhaṃ passāmi sadevake loke … attanā samādhisampannataraṃ aññaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, yam'ahaṃ sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya vihareyyaṃ.

59670.meaning1: stability of mind as an element of awakening; meditative composure as a factor of enlightenment
59670.meaning2: concentration as a constituent of awakening

examples.text: yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno passaddhakāyassa sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati, samādhisambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti.
yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo samādhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya.

59672.meaning1: leading to samadhi; conducive to meditative composure
59672.commentary: (DNa) upacārasamādhiṃ vā appanāsamādhiṃ vā saṃvattayantī'ti samādhisaṃvattanikānī'ti vuccanti. (ANa) samādhisaṃvattanikānī'ti maggasamādhi-phalasamādhi-nibbattakāni.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni.

59673.meaning1: for whom meditative composure is the (whole of) monkhood; equating samādhi with ascetic life
59673.commentary: (SNa) samādhisārakā samādhisāmaññā'ti samādhiṃ'y'eva sārañ'ca sāmaññañ'ca maññanti. mayhaṃ pana sāsane na etaṃ sāraṃ, vipassanāmaggaphalāni sāraṃ. so tvaṃ samādhito parihāyanto kasmā cintesi sāsanato parihāyāmī'ti.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhato evaṃ hoti, no c'ass'āhaṃ parihāyāmī'ti. ye te, assaji, samaṇabrāhmaṇā samādhisārakā samādhisāmaññā tesaṃ taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhataṃ evaṃ hoti, no c'assu mayaṃ parihāyāmā'ti.

59674.meaning1: with meditative composure in common; with similar stability of mind

examples.text: samādhisāmaññagatānaṃ sataṃ samādhikathā ca no bhavissati, sā ca no pavattinī bhavissati, sā ca no phāsu bhavissati. paññāsāmaññagatānaṃ sataṃ paññākathā ca no bhavissati, sā ca no pavattinī bhavissati, sā ca no phāsu bhavissatī'ti.
katame cattāro? sīlasāro, samādhisāro, paññāsāro, vimuttisāro, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro sārā'ti.

59676.meaning1: for whom meditative composure is the essence; taking meditative composure as essential
59676.commentary: (SNa) samādhisārakā samādhisāmaññā'ti samādhiṃ'y'eva sārañ'ca sāmaññañ'ca maññanti. mayhaṃ pana sāsane na etaṃ sāraṃ, vipassanāmaggaphalāni sāraṃ. so tvaṃ samādhito parihāyanto kasmā cintesi sāsanato parihāyāmī'ti.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhato evaṃ hoti, no c'ass'āhaṃ parihāyāmī'ti. ye te, assaji, samaṇabrāhmaṇā samādhisārakā samādhisāmaññā tesaṃ taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhataṃ evaṃ hoti, no c'assu mayaṃ parihāyāmā'ti.

59677.meaning1: pleasure of meditative composure; happiness of perfect peace of mind

examples.text: katamāni dve? samādhisukhañ'ca asamādhisukhañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve sukhāni.

59686.meaning2: Chapter 1 of the Saccasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

59688.meaning1: stilled; settled; centred; brought under control
59688.commentary: (THIa) tato cittaṃ samādhesiṃ, assaṃ bhadraṃvajāniyan'ti yathā assaṃ bhadraṃ ājāniyaṃ kusalo sārathi sukhena sāreti, evaṃ mayhaṃ cittaṃ sukhen'eva samādhesiṃ, vipassanāsamādhinā samāhitaṃ akāsiṃ.

examples.text: disvā adantaṃ damitaṃ, manussānaṃ vasaṃ gataṃ, tato cittaṃ samādhesiṃ, khalu tāya vanaṃ gatā'ti.

59689.synonym: tulya, nibbisesa, sadisa, sadisopama, sama, sarikkha, sādisa

examples.text: samānabhāgaṃ kubbetha, gāme akkuṭṭhavanditaṃ, manopadosaṃ rakkheyya, santo anuṇṇato care.
tulyasevī'ti, attanā samānasevī

59690.commentary: (VINa) samānasaṃvāsako'ti hi vadatā cittena aviyogo dassito hoti.

examples.text: samaggo nāma saṅgho samānasaṃvāsako samānasīmāyaṃ ṭhito.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'iccho samāno, app'iccho'ti maṃ jāneyyun'ti na icchati
samaṇā samaṇā'ti vo, bhikkhave, jano sañjānāti. tumhe ca pana, ke tumhe'ti puṭṭhā samānā, samaṇ'āmhā'ti paṭijānātha.

59692.meaning1: having the same wish; with the same intention

59693.meaning1: fact of having the same interests

examples.text: dānam'pi ca atthacariyatam'pi ca piyavadatañ'ca samānachandatañ'ca kariyacariyasusaṅgahaṃ bahūnaṃ, anavamatena guṇena yāti saggaṃ.

59694.commentary: (PMa) samān'attatā'ti saha mānena samāno, saparimāṇo saparigaṇano'ti attho. samāno parassa attā etenā'ti samān'atto, samān'attassa bhāvo samān'attatā, ayaṃ mayā hīno, ayaṃ mayā sadiso, ayaṃ mayā adhiko'ti parigaṇetvā tadanurūpena upacaraṇaṃ karaṇan'ti attho. samānasukhadukkhatā samān'attatā'ti ca vadanti.

examples.text: cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, saṅgahavatthūni. katamāni cattāri? dānaṃ, peyyavajjaṃ, atthacariyā, samān'attatā, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri saṅgahavatthūnī'ti.

59696.meaning1: (gram) indeclinable word with the same meaning

examples.text: deve abhido [abhide, abhidosaṃ abhido'ti abhisaddena samān'attha-nipātapadaṃ]
samānabhāgaṃ kubbetha, gāme akkuṭṭhavanditaṃ, manopadosaṃ rakkheyya, santo anuṇṇato care.
samānabhāvaṃ kubbetha, gāme akkuṭṭhavanditaṃ, manopadosaṃ rakkheyya, santo anuṇṇato care.
